# Introduction {#introduction}

## About this Extension

This extension adds a **premium**, **interactive** progress indicator to your Quarto presentations.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Key Feature
Built fully native as a **Quarto Lua Filter** — just one single file, zero external dependencies.
:::

[View on GitHub](https://github.com/ofurkancoban/QuartoProgressIndicator)

## How It Works

1. **Native Lua Filter**: Clean integration with your Quarto project via `filters:`.
2. **Intersection & Mutation Observers**: Intelligently tracks active slides and layout changes.
3. **Auto-hide**: Fades out automatically when the presentation is idle.
4. **Persistence**: All custom colors, shortcuts, and settings are saved to `localStorage`.

## Full Color Persistence

All color changes are **automatically saved** to `localStorage`:

- ✅ Active dot color
- ✅ Inactive dot color
- ✅ Label text color
- ✅ Background color

You can also rely on **Theme Inheritance**: The extension automatically detects your Reveal.js theme and pulls its primary accent color on startup!

# Animations {#animations}

## Active Slide Animations

Add flair to your active slide with CSS animations:

| Animation | Effect |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Pulse** | Soft breathing scale effect |
| **Glow** | Luminous halo highlight |
| **Bounce** | Playful vertical jump |
| **None** | Clean, flat style |

# Slide Visibility Manager {#visibility}

## Per-Slide Dot & Bar Control

Open settings (`i`) and scroll to **Slide Visibility**.

Each slide has **two independent checkboxes**:

| Column | What it controls |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Dot** | Include this slide as a dot in the indicator |
| **Bar** | Show the indicator bar when on this slide |

::: {.callout-note}
All visibility settings are **saved automatically** — changes persist across reloads.
:::

## Class-Based Hiding

Alternatively, add `.hide-progress` to any slide:

```markdown
## Q&A Slide {.hide-progress}
```

Or use `.skip-progress` to omit a slide from dots while keeping the bar visible.

# Page Number: Dots Only {#page-number}

## Override Slide Counter

Enable **"Page Number: Dots Only"** in settings to replace the default slide counter with a **dot-based count**:

- Regular counter: `5 / 18` (total slides)
- Dots-only counter: `3 / 12` (only counted dots)

::: {.callout-tip}
Dots-only counter **automatically updates** when you add or remove slides from the indicator using the Slide Visibility Manager.
:::

# Configuration {#config}

## Installation

```bash
quarto add ofurkancoban/QuartoProgressIndicator
```

## YAML Setup

```yaml
filters:
  - ofurkancoban/progress-indicator

format:
  revealjs:
    progress-indicator:
      position: "bottom"    # top | bottom
      alignment: "center"   # left | center | right
      style: "dots"         # dots | bar
      hide-on-title: true
```

## CSS Customization

```css
:root {
  --primary-color: #3b60e4;
  --inactive-color: #bbbbbb;
  --indicator-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
  --label-color: #888;
  --dot-size: 8px;
  --section-spacing: 15px;
}
```

# Shortcuts & Tips {#shortcuts}

## Keyboard Shortcuts

| Shortcut | Action |
| :--- | :--- |
| <kbd>i</kbd> | Open/Close Settings Panel |
| <kbd>x</kbd> | Hide/Show Indicator |

::: {.callout-tip}
You can **customize** these keyboard shortcuts anytime through the settings panel to avoid conflicts with your other tools.
:::

## Export & Import

Save your configuration for re-use:

- **📋 Copy Config** — Exports current settings as YAML/CSS snippet
- **💾 Export JSON** — Downloads settings as a JSON file
- **📂 Import JSON** — Uploads a previously saved settings file
- **🔄 Reset** — Restores all defaults
